What does that mean for a school?

Schools pay £2 per pupil per year, using the same pupil rate as families.

For school access or a question about the annual price, email enquiries@kickmaths.co.uk.

Why keep the price low?

Extra maths practice should be within reach of more families. KickMaths combines a low pupil price with curriculum topics and understandable progress reports, so adults can choose useful work rather than pay for a generic collection of maths activities.

Why we created KickMaths

Frequently asked questions

Do schools pay a different rate?

No. Families and schools both pay £2 per pupil per year. A school with 30 pupils pays £60 per year.

Do player credits cost extra money?

No. Cosmetic credits are earned through eligible maths practice and the first-game starter reward. They are separate from the annual pupil price.

Is there automatic device synchronisation?

No. Progress is saved in the browser used to play. Backup and Restore can transfer it to another device.
